svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Detailed solution architecture for guided payroll activation on Google Cloud: clients, web portal and edge security feed a six-stage activation pipeline (prepare, map, validate and simulate, activate, remediate, review), supported by event-driven orchestration, a learning loop, a data and knowledge layer, observability, and security.
svg.text: Event-driven, AI-assisted activation pipeline on Google Cloud (React, Python FastAPI, Cloud Run)
ACTIVATION PIPELINE: ONE CLOUD RUN SERVICE PER EPIC
corrected records revalidated, never the whole batch
Feedback and continuous learning (AI gets better each batch)
people approve every mapping; AI never activates a record
Data and knowledge layer (read and written by every stage)
Security and governance (applied to every layer)
• AI suggests, people approve, deterministic rules decide validity
• One bad record never blocks the batch
• Every change is audited and explainable
• Tenant data isolated at the API, database and storage layers
Delivery: Terraform, Cloud Build, Cloud Deploy, Artifact Registry, Binary Authorization. Environments: dev, test, staging, production.
